Name: Tenkai Spouse Elegance - Animated Portraits and Seasonal Sprites
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
[b][size=5]Tenkai Spouse Elegance[/size][/b]
Animated portraits and seasonal sprites for all twelve spouses
By Tenkai Tenshi | Version 0.2.12 beta

Give married life in Pelican Town a fresh look. Tenkai Spouse Elegance reimagines the twelve marriage candidates with an elegant wardrobe, redesigned dialogue portraits and seasonal character sprites. Each character keeps a distinct style, with coordinated portrait and sprite outfits.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru and Penny.
Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian and Shane.

[b]WHAT IS INCLUDED[/b]
[list]
[*]Four seasonal sprite and portrait sets per character: spring, summer, autumn and winter.[/*]
[*]Beach variants for all twelve characters, plus work variants for Maru at the hospital and Sam and Shane at JojaMart. These appear when the game requests the corresponding native texture.[/*]
[*]Redesigned expression portraits, with mouth animation while dialogue text appears and periodic blinking. This is frame animation, not recorded speech or audio lip sync.[/*]
[*]Directional sprites, walking frames and artwork for existing special poses, including wedding and kiss frames.[/*]
[*]144 Spanish marriage dialogue entries across the twelve characters. These require the game language to be Spanish.[/*]
[/list]
[b]WHEN THE REDESIGN APPEARS[/b]
By default, MarriedOnly is enabled: visuals apply to characters married to your farmer and to an engaged partner on the wedding day. Set MarriedOnly to false in config.json to use the visuals earlier. This option changes appearance eligibility only.

[b]REQUIREMENTS AND INSTALLATION[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer. Content Patcher is not required by this mod.
1. Install SMAPI: https://smapi.io/
2. Close the game before installing or updating.
3. Extract the mod download so that Mods/Tenkai Spouse Elegance/manifest.json exists. Keep only one installed copy of this mod.
4. Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
When updating, keep a copy of your existing config.json if you want to retain your preferences.

[b]CONFIGURATION[/b]
Enabled: turn the mod on or off.
MarriedOnly: restrict the visual redesign to spouses (enabled by default).
SeasonalOutfits: use the seasonal wardrobe; disabling it selects the spring set.
AnimateMouth: animate portrait mouths as text appears.
Blink: enable portrait blinking.
NewSpanishDialogue: enable the added Spanish marriage dialogue.

[b]RELATIONSHIPS AND OTHER MODS[/b]
This is a visual and dialogue mod. It does not add multiple marriages or control kiss eligibility, position, timing or interaction. HaremLove is optional and handles its own relationship and kiss mechanics separately; vanilla relationship mechanics can also be used.
Mods replacing the same character sprites or portraits may conflict. Compatibility with every replacement pack or multiplayer setup has not been verified.

[b]BETA STATUS[/b]
0.2.12 is a candidate/beta build. Local asset, package and code checks have been completed; final visual approval inside a real save remains pending. Seasonal transitions, special poses and multiplayer still need in-game review. The existing Harvey beach walking artwork has known fragmented areas and remains a beta limitation.
The latest change restores ten fabric pixels in Leah's summer kiss pose to improve skirt continuity. It does not change the kiss interaction engine.

[b]ABOUT THE GALLERY[/b]
The images are compositions of actual PNG assets included in this build. They are asset showcases, not screenshots captured inside a game save. Animated GIFs demonstrate the included portrait cells; their preview timing is illustrative.

[b]CREDITS AND AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
Mod author: Tenkai Tenshi.
Stardew Valley and its characters: ConcernedApe.
Modding framework: SMAPI and its contributors.
Artwork created with generative AI assistance (OpenAI ImageGen), then adapted and assembled for the game's sprite and portrait format. Code and publication text were also developed with AI assistance. The gallery uses the resulting runtime assets rather than concept illustrations.
